title: Jeonbuk education office school bus system leak exposes student addresses and bus routes
date_note: Date the office posted its notice, as reported by Dailysecu (published 20 Nov); the Ministry of Education Cyber Safety Center told the office of a suspected leak on 15 Nov.
geo_basis: headquarters (province education office, Jeonju); no victim city stated
summary: Data leaked from the Jeonbuk Provincial Office of Education's school bus management system after a 15 November Ministry of Education notice, Dailysecu and Segye Ilbo report: eight items including student name, address, parent contact and bus route. Segye (19 November) says the office shut the system and asked police to investigate the next day, citing the office for more than 9,900 parent contacts; affected students are still being counted.
plain: Student names, addresses, parent phone numbers and school bus routes leaked from a South Korean provincial education office system. The office has asked police to investigate; the number of students affected is still being counted.
exec: Student addresses, parent contacts and bus routes leaked from a school bus system; the office has asked police to investigate and the scale is still being counted.
action: The office urges residents to beware of calls and texts impersonating officials, Segye Ilbo reports.
impact: Eight items listed by the office: school name, student name, grade, class, student address, parent contact, bus plate number and route.

validation.note: Dailysecu (20 Nov) and Segye Ilbo (19 Nov) each report the leak and the eight items. Segye reports more than 9,900 (9900여) parent contacts and the police referral; the office's own notice (posted 17 Nov) was also read: it lists the same eight items and says the number affected and any further leak are still under investigation. Validator figure-qualifier warning: the Korean 여 suffix means "more than", which the checker cannot read.

review.note: stronger than the source: 'police are investigating' changed to office asked police to investigate (Segye); 15 Nov notice, 8 items, 9900여 contacts, impersonation advice checked against Dailysecu and Segye

evidence.quote: 보호자 연락처만 9900여 건에 달하며, 주민등록번호는 수집하지않아 유출되지 않은 것으로 파악됐다.
